what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Angola in Brazil: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1629 Angolan asylum seekers in Brazil, 9.6% of all asylum seekers from Angola.
Refugees from Angola, a separate group, live mostly in France, Canada, Germany and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Angola with UNITA in 1995 and from 1998 to 2002.
It also records armed conflict over Cabinda territory in periods from 1995 to 2025, most recently with FLEC-FAC-TN.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 206 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 8443, at the end of 2023; the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Brazil.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Brazil only.
